verdict.rationale: The evidence says Runpod has GPUs across 30+ regions and offers Secure vs Community Cloud tiers, but no item documents a user selecting the region or data center where their data (for example a network volume) is stored, or any residency guarantee. The region count and cloud-tier choice are adjacent facts, not the story's capability. Network-volume docs describe persistence and S3 access only, with no location control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
